# Hydrometeorologic Dryness Index (HDI)

#HDI based on https://nph.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/nph.14668

(unit; kPa m−3 H2O m3 soil) 

```{r}
load(file=here("Dscmet2016_2024.RData")) 
wood_colors <- c(earlywood = "#1f78b4", latewood = "#33a02c")  


#df with just SWC and VPD + flags
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56 <- Dscmet2016_2024|>select(c(
  Date,SOILWC_MEAN_0_50_01,Flag_SOILWC_MEAN_0_50_01,VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01,Flag_VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01))
#replacing bad VPD flags
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56$VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01[Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56$Flag_VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01 %in% c("Q", "V")] <- NA
#mb to kpa 
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56$VPD_kpa<-Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56$VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01/10

#fixing issue of multiple rows fir the same time stamp
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed <- Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56 %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    SOILWC_MEAN_0_50_01 = first(na.omit(SOILWC_MEAN_0_50_01)),
    Flag_SOILWC_MEAN_0_50_01 = first(na.omit(Flag_SOILWC_MEAN_0_50_01)),
    VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01 = first(na.omit(VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01)),
    Flag_VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01 = first(na.omit(Flag_VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#adding HDI column
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$VPD_kpa <- Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$VPD_MEAN_5600_0_01/10
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed <- Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed|> mutate(
  HDI = VPD_kpa / SOILWC_MEAN_0_50_01)


#condensing time series - starting with adding hour, day, year columns
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$Date<-as.POSIXct(Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$Date,format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$hour <- format(
  Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$Date, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00")
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$day <- format(
  Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$Date, "%Y-%m-%d")
Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$year <- format(
  Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed$Date, "%Y")
#getting daily averages - starting with adding a day column

save(Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed,file=here("EL RWL/Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed.RData"))

#hourly mean
Dscmet_HDI_hourly_mean<- Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed |> 
  group_by(hour) |> 
  summarise(mean_HDI = mean(HDI))
Dscmet_HDI_hourly_mean$hour <- as.Date(Dscmet_HDI_hourly_mean$hour)
save(Dscmet_HDI_hourly_mean,file=here("EL RWL/Dscmet_HDI_hourly_mean.RData"))
#hourly max
Dscmet_HDI_hourly_max <- Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed |> 
  group_by(hour) |> 
  summarise(max_HDI = max(HDI))
Dscmet_HDI_hourly_max$hour <- as.Date(Dscmet_HDI_hourly_max$hour)
save(Dscmet_HDI_hourly_max,file=here("EL RWL/Dscmet_HDI_hourly_max.RData"))

#plot HD +/- 1 week
ggplot(Dscmet_SWC50_VPD56_hourly, aes(x = hour, y = mean_HDI)) +
    geom_point()+
  scale_x_date(
    limits = as.Date(c("2021-06-21", "2021-07-06")),
    date_breaks = "2 days",
    date_labels = "%b %d"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Mean Hourly Hydrometeorologic Dryness Index") +
  theme_minimal()

#daily mean
Dscmet_HDI_daily_mean<- Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed |> 
  group_by(day) |> 
  summarise(mean_HDI = mean(HDI))
Dscmet_HDI_daily_mean$day <- as.Date(Dscmet_HDI_daily_mean$day)
save(Dscmet_HDI_daily_mean,file=here("EL RWL/Dscmet_HDI_daily_mean.RData"))
#daily max
Dscmet_HDI_daily_max <- Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed |> 
  group_by(day) |> 
  summarise(max_HDI = max(HDI))
Dscmet_HDI_daily_max$day <- as.Date(Dscmet_HDI_daily_max$day)
save(Dscmet_HDI_daily_max,file=here("EL RWL/Dscmet_HDI_daily_max.RData"))

#plot HD +/- 4 weeks
ggplot(Dscmet_SWC50_VPD56_daily, aes(x = day, y = max_HDI)) +
    geom_point()+
  scale_x_date(
    limits = as.Date(c("2021-05-30", "2021-07-26")),
    date_breaks = "5 days",
    date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Max Daily Hydrometeorologic Dryness Index") +
  theme_minimal()

#max yearly
Dscmet_SWC50_VPD56_yearly <- Dscmet_combined_SWC50_VPD56_condensed |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(max_HDI = max(HDI,na.rm = TRUE))
Dscmet_SWC50_VPD56_yearly$year <- as.double(Dscmet_SWC50_VPD56_yearly$year)
#plot
ggplot(Dscmet_SWC50_VPD56_yearly, aes(x = year, y = max_HDI)) +
    geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Max Annual Hydrometeorologic Dryness Index") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#naming object to list all RWL files in EL RWL
rwl_files <- list.files(here("EL RWL"), pattern = "\\.rwl$", full.names = TRUE)
#reading and storing each file from above 
batch_read_rwl <- function(file_path) {
  df <- read.rwl(file_path)
  
  # Convert rownames to a year column BEFORE pivot
  df$year <- as.integer(rownames(df))
  
  df_long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "ring_width") %>%
   mutate(
tree_id = str_replace(sample_id, "([AB])_([EL])$", ""),
  wood_type = case_when(
    str_ends(sample_id, "_E") ~ "earlywood",
    str_ends(sample_id, "_L") ~ "latewood",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  wood_type = factor(wood_type, levels = c("earlywood", "latewood"))
)
  return(df_long)
}


# Apply to all files and bind into one data frame
combined_rwl <- bind_rows(lapply(rwl_files, batch_read_rwl))
# Average A and B cores
combined_rwl_mean <- combined_rwl |>
  group_by(year, tree_id, wood_type) |>
  summarise(ring_width = mean(ring_width, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(combined_rwl_mean, here("EL RWL/mean_combined_ring_widths.csv"))

# wide version of raw data
combined_rwl_mean_wide <- combined_rwl_mean|>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tree_id, values_from = ring_width)
write.csv(combined_rwl_mean_wide, here("EL RWL/combined_rwl_mean_wide.csv"))

#wide version of normalized data by shifting everything to 0->1 for each wood type and tree in the long format
normalized_mean_wide <- combined_rwl_mean %>%
  group_by(tree_id,wood_type) %>%
  mutate(
    ring_width_norm = (ring_width - min(ring_width, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                      (max(ring_width, na.rm = TRUE) - min(ring_width, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(year, tree_id, wood_type, ring_width_norm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tree_id, values_from = ring_width_norm)

write.csv(normalized_mean_wide, here("EL RWL/normalized_mean_combined_ring_widths_wide.csv"))
```

```{r}
normalized_mean_wide_no652B2 <- normalized_mean_wide |>select(!(c(`648_B2E`,`648_B2L`)))
combined_rwl_mean_wide_no652B2 <-combined_rwl_mean_wide |> select(!(c(`648_B2E`,`648_B2L`)))

plot_tree_raw <- function(tree_col, data_wide) {
  # Subset and rename
  df <- data_wide %>%
    select(year, wood_type, all_of(tree_col)) %>%
    rename(ring_width = all_of(tree_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ring_width))

  # Skip trees with no data
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    message(paste("Skipping", tree_col, "- no valid data"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Safe range for x and y
  first_year <- min(df$year, na.rm = TRUE)
  last_year  <- max(df$year, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(df$ring_width, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(df$ring_width, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Identify min/max years by wood type
  minmax_years <- df %>%
    group_by(wood_type) %>%
    filter(ring_width == min(ring_width, na.rm = TRUE) | 
           ring_width == max(ring_width, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Build the plot
  ggplot(df, aes(x = year, y = ring_width, color = wood_type)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    # Heat dome year
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2021, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    # Min/max vertical lines
    geom_vline(data = minmax_years, aes(xintercept = year, color = wood_type),
               linetype = "dashed", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = wood_colors, na.translate = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(first_year, last_year),
      breaks = seq(first_year, last_year, by = 3)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Seasonwood Ring Widths: Tree ID", tree_col),
      x = "Year",
      y = "Ring Width (mm)",
      color = "Wood Type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}
 
tree_cols <- colnames(combined_rwl_mean_wide_no652B2)[!(colnames(combined_rwl_mean_wide_no652B2) %in% c("year", "wood_type"))]

for (tree in tree_cols) {
  tree_title <- str_remove(tree, "_$")

  # Generate the plot
p <- plot_tree_raw(tree, combined_rwl_mean_wide_no652B2) +
    labs(title = paste("Raw Seasonwood Ring Widths: Tree ID", tree_title))

# Skip if plot is NULL
if (!is.null(p)) {
print(p)

    # Save plot to file (with underscore in filename)
    ggsave(
      filename = here("Plots", paste0("ringwidth_plot_", tree, ".png")),
      plot = p)
  }
}

```

```{r}
# Compute E/L ratio
combined_rwl_mean_ratio <- combined_rwl_mean %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = wood_type, values_from = ring_width) %>%
  mutate(ratio_EL = earlywood / latewood)

# Unique tree IDs
tree_ids <- unique(combined_rwl_mean_ratio$tree_id)

# Loop through tree IDs and plot individually
for (tree in tree_ids) {
  df_tree <- combined_rwl_mean_ratio %>%
    filter(tree_id == tree)

  p <- ggplot(df_tree, aes(x = year, y = ratio_EL)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2021, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Earlywood/Latewood Ratio Over Time - Tree", gsub("_", "", tree)),
      x = "Year",
      y = "E:L Ratio"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # Save the plot
#  ggsave(
#    filename = paste0("Plots/EL_ratio_", tree, ".png"),
#    plot = p,
#    width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300  )

  print(p)  # Optional: view in RStudio
}
```
